items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: Yeah that was one of my gigs at the Latin Casino that Curtis really didn't enjoy, that I loved.

ctx.x: Yeah. So apparently Sammy Davis Jr. tried to fire you for having long hair?

Longer hair than him. He had straight hair and it was down to like right here. Yeah that was one of my gigs at the Latin Casino that Curtis really didn't enjoy, that I loved. And plus in those days I would go smoke a reefer and come in smelling of pot and everybody knew that I did and nobody said a word because I could play the music blindfolded. I mean they loved the fact that here was this 15, 16—year—old kid who was in the union and could play better than them and grew up in Philadelphia and they were all…
Were there any black students when you were there? Because I know Joe Wilder and some other black musicians went there. This would have been years before you.
